content.text: Core persistence and service operations are in place. I’m now applying redirection before issue writes/events, and adapting notifications so assignment, overdue, and mention routing all use the same workspace scoped absence lookup.

Routing now consults the workspace’s absence when an issue assignment is created or changed, and in notification fan out for overdue items and mentions. I’m checking type consistency and ensuring created issue events use the resolved assignee.
